main.description: Patient-issued, DID-bound, scope-limited, time-bound delegation token. Grants the `granteeDid` permission to operate on a defined set of resources (typically `com.etzhayyim.karute.*` AT URIs) under a specific stated purpose. Always signed by the granter; revocable. Used as the bridging primitive between etzhayyim (PHI custody) and vendor iryo.etzhayyim.com (insurance billing) and any third-party EHR / second-opinion clinic. Per ADR-2605231400.

granterDid.description: DID of the principal granting access (patient or authorized representative)

granteeDid.description: DID of the recipient actor authorized to act

purpose.description: Stated purpose — narrows the lawful basis of the grantee's processing. `deploy-execution` is the agent-led-deploy authority extension per ADR-2605232000 — bound to a specific agent DID with scope = deploy.* NSIDs.

scope.description: Lexicon NSIDs the grantee may read (e.g. ['com.etzhayyim.karute.encounter']). Use wildcards sparingly; least-privilege is the default.

resourceUris.description: Optional explicit AT URI allowlist. When empty, all records under `scope` collections in `granterDid`'s PDS are in-scope.

downstreamRedistribution.description: If false, grantee MUST NOT re-issue derived capabilities to other actors

auditWebhookDid.description: Optional auditor DID that receives an event each time the capability is invoked

delegationPath.description: Optional DID chain proving this capability was issued under a parent capability (e.g. a guardian capability for a minor patient)

signature.description: Ed25519 signature by `granterDid` over the canonicalized payload (everything except signature itself)
